# Compute Engine

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `cloud.google.com/go/compute@v1.72.0` · last audited 2026-10-26 (`cf047c847`)

## Coverage

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Feature families | 8 (5 ok, 2 partial, 1 gap) |
| Known gaps | 9 |
| Deferred items | 0 |
| Resource leaks | unknown |

### Known gaps

- Load balancing: service attachments, certificate maps, regional TCP/SSL certificates managed by Certificate Manager, backend service patch fields such as outlier detection are stored without effect, urlMaps.invalidateCache validates the rule and records an operation only (no CDN cache exists), and forwardingRules.patch (networkTier only) does not cross-check the tier against the reserved address, and managed certificates never leave PROVISIONING. No traffic is forwarded and nothing is probed (see BackendServices.GetHealth and TargetPools.GetHealth). Backend bucket existence is not checked against gcpstorage. Cloud Armor security policies are state only: there is no HTTP load balancer data plane, so SRC_IPS_V1 and CEL rules are never evaluated and nothing is allowed or denied; aggregatedList, listPreconfiguredExpressionSets, regional and organization policies, associations, edge/backend bucket attachment and adaptive protection behaviour are not modelled.
- Instance groups: utilization-based autoscaling has no metric source; listErrors and instanceFlexibilityPolicy are not implemented; instance creation errors fail the whole call instead of surfacing as group errors; autohealing probes only reach instances that carry the gopherstack-health-endpoint metadata key (no guest network exists), and gRPC checks are a TCP connect. Stateful policy: ephemeral external IPs are kept by reserving them under a name chosen here, and per-instance config disks/IPs apply only when the instance is (re)created. Resize requests have no capacity queue: ACCEPTED always succeeds after timing.Done unless creation fails.
- Instance templates from sourceInstance in another project are 404-class unsupported, DEFAULT disk instantiation does not create a custom image, and regional-only fields beyond the stored properties are not modelled; GRPC_WITH_TLS health checks and regional composite health checks are not modelled.
- Interconnects and interconnect attachments (so HA VPN over Cloud Interconnect), shared VPC, licenses, instant snapshot groups, regional disk async replication and policies, machine image encryption and future/aggregate reservations are not routed (404). VPN: no IPsec or BGP runs, so a tunnel only reaches ESTABLISHED against a reciprocal tunnel in the same project, BGP sessions learn no routes and no dynamic routes appear in routes.list; tunnel cipherSuite is stored without effect; the sharedSecretHash algorithm and detailedStatus texts are chosen here. Network peering supports the CONSENSUS strategy for deletion only (requestRemovePeering, cancelRequestRemovePeering and removePeering after both sides requested; the post-acknowledgement cancel states are inferred from the NetworkPeeringConnectionStatusConsensusState enum comments), not for updatePeering proposals (updateStatus is always IN_SYNC), stores the public-IP subnet route flags without effect (all emulator subnets are private or special-use ranges), and peer networks must exist in the emulator; peering routes are not added to routes.list. Resource policies are state only: schedules never take snapshots or start/stop instances, resourceStatus.instanceSchedulePolicy run times are not computed and status never becomes EXPIRED.
- Instances: GPUs at insert are rejected or stored without effect; aliasIpv6Ranges and BYOIP subnet prefixes are 400; Local SSD for series outside the machine catalog and the N1 T4-GPU count limit are not modelled and local SSD data is never held. instances.update uses a modelled field classification (see Instances.Update); getSerialPortOutput returns empty output and getGuestAttributes is always 404 because no guest runs.
- The default-route-<hash> name is derived from the subnetwork self link rather than random; the real hash input is unknown. nextHopHub routes (Network Connectivity Center) are 400.
- Error message texts for state conflicts (resourceNotReady on setMachineType/reset/detach/suspend/resume/setScheduling), peering overlap and duplicate errors, subnet route delete, resourceInUseByAnotherResource wording, required-field and validation messages, and the firewall rule for ingress without sources were chosen without a production reference.
- Only a fixed set of 15 regions, 46 zones, 9 image families, e2/n2/n1-standard machine types and 3 persistent disk types exist; image point releases are pinned, region quotas and Project usage quotas are not modelled, and the status/progress timing is a fixed model.
- The emulator does not enforce IAM or return permission errors.
